title: Reading music with age and cutting hair
summary: He reads with eyeglasses and now works only cutting hair a couple of days.

story.theme_name: Illness, injury and the deaths of colleagues
story.community_name: Illness, injury and death among jazz musicians

blocks.x: That did it? Yeah. Well, look, they're old dancers. You used to play like you played a shot at the mazooka. Mm-hmm. You don't play that anymore. No. No shot at the mazooka. See, when you're young, your eyes is good. Mm-hmm. They're old. They got some young people, eyes ain't no good.
You still read music? Well, your eyes must be pretty good.
I got to use my eyeglasses. I have to use the eyeglasses. Then what I wake in the shop with is different than the one where I play the music.
Do you, uh, still work at all? Just, just cutting hair, huh? Yeah.
That's all I do. I started working after a while. About two days of work, unless it be, get the customary to now and now. Mm-hmm.
I thought I have toga or something.
